Subject: Kickoff: Dedicated capacity MAP for OptiSoft - GPU pool & throughput targets

Hi Jason / Priya —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our discussion, this thread will hold the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for OptiSoft's Dedicated capacity evaluation. The goal of this kickoff is to align on roles, define capacity & perf targets, and agree on a short evaluation plan and close timeline so we can scope Dedicated pools and queue up contract steps.

High-level agenda for this thread / kickoff:
- Roles & owners (internal + OptiSoft)
- Current expected throughput / peak concurrency / latency targets
- Model inventory and workload profile for PoC
- Evaluation plan + acceptance criteria (2-week PoC suggested)
- Timeline to decision & contract milestones

Proposed internal owners (please ping if different):
- Marissa Cole (Account Lead) — primary contact for timeline / commercial
- Markus Klein (Solutions Eng) — perf testing & PoC runbook
- Vivek Kulkarni (Dedicated Prod) — capacity sizing & GPU pool ops
- Lauren Bishop (Program Manager) — kickoff scheduling and MAP tracking
- Rishi Malhotra (Capacity Planner) — throughput/queue sizing estimates

Initial asks for OptiSoft to help us size the pool:
1) Expected average and peak request rate (rps) and token output per request.
2) Target p95 generation latency (ms) and acceptable error/failure rate.
3) Peak concurrent sessions / user-facing concurrency.
4) Model families you plan to serve (names/approx size) and whether quantized variants are acceptable.
5) Any regulatory/security requirements (SOC2, data retention, audit logs).

Suggested PoC acceptance criteria (we can refine):
- Sustained throughput equal to the 95th percentile expected load for 2 continuous hours
- p95 latency for generation under 250 ms for the primary model; p99 targets to be discussed
- End-to-end error rate < 1% during test windows
- KV/prefix cache hit behavior validated on your representative prompt set

Proposed timeline (flexible):
- This week: align roles + share initial numbers (you)
- Week of May 18: tech deep-dive (Markus + OptiSoft infra)
- Week of May 26: 2-week PoC runs against staging traffic
- Week of Jun 8–12: decision week / contract review (commercial readiness)

Attachments: OptiSoft_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones), capacity_targets_OptiSoft.pdf (initial template).

Links: Drive MAP folder and HubSpot deal are in related_links for reference.

Jason/Priya — can you share the initial throughput numbers and who from your side will own the infra testing? If you prefer a call, I can coordinate with Lauren to lock a time.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. Quick answers from our side to get started: 

- Expected average RPS (steady): ~45 rps
- Expected peak RPS (burst windows): ~150 rps (30–60s bursts repeated during business hours)
- Peak concurrent sessions: ~60 active sessions during peak
- Model surface: 3 models — two LLaMA-derivative ~13B class and one 30B customer-tuned model
- Target p95 generation latency: < 250 ms for the 13B models; < 400 ms acceptable for the tuned 30B model
- Token output per request: ~120–220 tokens
- Security: we are SOC2 compliant; we will require audit logs and an SLA for data retention and access controls

For infra ownership: Priya Shah (cc'd) will own orchestration and SRE coordination. Priya — can you confirm availability for a technical deep-dive next week (May 18–20)? Also please share any staging traffic replay capability or a representative prompt set we can provide.

On the PoC acceptance criteria — the p95 target looks reasonable. We may need to refine the sustained throughput window (45–60 minutes is more representative for us rather than 2 hours), but we can finalize during the tech deep-dive.

Thanks,
Jason
VP Product | OptiSoft

Adding a quick note on sizing options from Dedicated ops side. Based on Jason's numbers, we should evaluate two pool configurations during the PoC:

Option A (cost-optimized):
- A100 40GB instances in an autoscaled pool
- Optimized kernel paths + int8 quantization for 13B models
- Expected to meet ~140–160 rps bursts with horizontal scaling

Option B (performance-optimized):
- H100 80GB instances with larger KV cache per device
- Bare-metal reserved lanes for the tuned 30B model to hit p95 targets

Markus — can you own the perf runbooks and coordinate test scripts with Priya? Rishi — please draft queue sizing for the A100 pool (burst capacity) and the reserved lane footprint for the H100 option.

We will also prepare a quick checklist for SOC2 evidence and audit-log retention options before the tech deep-dive. Lauren, please send calendar options for May 18–20.

—Vivek
